g.text: How intervention classes reshape later dispatch options
All six sources and all 12 interior doses per family | fixed nominal power normalization
S/F/E/P = SCS/FCS/ESS/PCC. Positive: expansion; negative: contraction. Curves: source median and IQR. Directional supports, not feasible volumes.
